new_value: Fixed: the capability table's anti-replay floor now survives LRU eviction (rust/lichen-gateway/src/capability.rs, commit 03c60167ab). Mechanism: a bounded monotone seq_floors ledger - evict_lru captures the victim's entry.seq as a floor BEFORE removal; every insert/refresh raises the floor to the new seq (monotone, never lowered); cached_seq returns max(entry.seq, floor), so the dispatch replay gate (resources.rs cached_seq -> verify_announcement strict-exceeds) refuses a replayed older announcement from an evicted announcer. Ledger bound: bound_seq_floors loop-drops lowest-IID stale floors (IIDs not in the table) while over CAPACITY_TABLE_CAPACITY, breaking only when all floors are active (floors == table size <= 256); documented bounded tradeoff: under sustained distinct-IID flood, long-evicted floors are recycled lowest-IID-first. Tests: eviction_preserves_replay_floor (seq 500 -> flood-evicted -> cached_seq still 500 -> stale 499 re-insert keeps the floor -> fresh 501 accepted) and floor_ledger_stays_bounded (320 egress inserts force repeated eviction+capture; ledger <= 256). Suite: 252 lib tests passed, fmt + clippy clean. Reviewer (kimi-k3) pass 1 traced the change and confirmed all semantics (existing 5 tests + both dispatch tests hold; eviction fires exactly at the i=193 flood insert; ledger oscillation stays <= 256 after every public call) - passes 2-3 lenses self-run (floor never lowers; seq-reset by the announcer itself is fail-closed per the strictly-exceeds spec rule; bound-loop termination). Python mirror of the same hole filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-97tr (bead 97tr); durable-across-restart floors remain out of scope (the whole table is unpersisted today - status quo; extension tracked if wanted). Commit: 03c60167ab.
